errors.text_span: in absteigender Reihenfolge der Anteile auflistet
errors.evidence: The description claims that all categories on the vertical axis are listed in descending order of their values. This is only true for the first group of categories (industries). The second group (company sizes) is not sorted by value; for example, 'Mittlere Betriebe' (~39%) has a higher value than 'Größere Betriebe' (~37%) but is listed below it.

errors.text_span: wobei kleinste Betriebe (1–9 Mitarbeiter) mit etwa 18 % am niedrigsten sind
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 'kleinste Betriebe' (micro-enterprises) as having the lowest share in the chart. The actual lowest share belongs to 'Baugewerbe' (construction), with a value of approximately 8%. The value for 'kleinste Betriebe' is approximately 19%, not 18%.

errors.text_span: Die Betriebsgrößen werden in drei Kategorien unterteilt: Kleinbetriebe (10–49), Mittlere Betriebe (50–249) und Größere Betriebe (250+)
errors.evidence: The description states that there are three company size categories, but the chart clearly shows four. The 'Kleinstbetriebe (1-9)' (micro-enterprises) category is missing from the description.

errors.text_span: wobei die Größeren Betriebe mit etwa 37 % den höchsten Anteil unter den Betriebsgrößen aufweisen
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that 'Größere Betriebe' (large companies) have the highest share among the company size categories. In fact, 'Mittlere Betriebe' (medium companies) have the highest share in this group, at approximately 39%.

errors.text_span: die Kategorien sind alphabetisch nach Branche und dann nach Betriebsgröße sortiert
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the categories are sorted alphabetically. The 'Branche' (industry) categories are sorted in descending order of their value, and the 'Betriebsgröße' (company size) categories are sorted by size class from largest to smallest, not alphabetically.
